title: Full Venue Buyouts
metaTitle: Full Venue Buyout in Mission Beach, San Diego
description: Book a full venue buyout at Miss B's Coconut Club in Mission Beach, San Diego with exclusive use of the open-air bar, tropical dining room and outdoor patio.
cardDesc: Take over the open-air bar, tropical dining room and outdoor patio for a private Mission Beach event at Miss B's Coconut Club.
body: A full Miss B's Coconut Club buyout gives your group exclusive use of the Mission Beach venue, including the open-air bar, tropical dining room and outdoor patio.
Work with the events team on food, drinks, space configuration, staffing and event flow for a private gathering at 3704 Mission Blvd.
